en.title: Live Big-Screen Range Display
en.excerpt: Connecting Archeris to stadium LED walls, projectors, and livestream overlays for interactive visual bracket displays.
en.content:
Big-Screen Display Mode

Archeris includes a specialized high-contrast dark theme display mode designed specifically for range LED walls, venue projectors, and spectator TV monitors.

Launching Full-Screen View

To open the stadium display:

  1. Open any elimination bracket in the Organizer Dashboard.
  2. Click Full Screen Display in the upper right corner.
  3. Connect the laptop to your HDMI stadium splitter or wireless display transmitter.

Real-Time Match Animations

When line scorekeepers submit match results, the stadium display animates the winner's advancement into the next round automatically via WebSockets without manual page refreshes.

OBS & Livestream Browser Sources

Broadcast engineers can add the bracket URL as a transparent Browser Source in OBS Studio to integrate live bracket trees directly into YouTube or Facebook live streams.
